resources.string: Reopen the tabs, cursors, scroll positions and explorer folders a project had when you last left it. Unsaved edits are always restored, whatever this says.
Start straight in the project you used last instead of the project list.
Projects kept running in the background

Leaving a project keeps its terminals and open files alive so it is exactly as you left it when you come back. Beyond this many, the one you left longest ago is ended (its unsaved edits are backed up first). 0 ends a project as soon as you leave it.
%1$s changed on disk. Keep your version or use the disk version before saving.
Deleted or unreadable as text on disk. Saving recreates it.
Changed on disk while you had unsaved edits. Saving is blocked until you choose.
You have unsaved edits and the file was changed outside the editor. Keeping your version overwrites the disk version when you save.
